central_problem: fallback、ranking 與 topic drift 如何被區分，而不是把所有結果湊成固定數量？
reader_takeaway: 保留診斷、relevance state 與 first weak layer，比靜默補結果更安全。

known_at_the_time.fact: 6/22 commits repeatedly refined domain-aware grouping, fallback diagnostics and source-record merge。
f33a48c explicitly tightened source-search budget and seeded balanced topics。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: provider fallback/diagnostics 與早期 search budget 已被當成工程責任記錄。

not_yet_available.fact: f33a48c 的 budget seed 不是後來 V5 的 pre-side-effect authoritative ledger。

observed_failures.symptom: progress log records provider timeout/429/failure risk and generic phrasing entering queries.
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: provider availability and query sanitation were still separate unresolved risks
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: fallback could preserve candidates, but relevance was not perfect
observed_failures.later_resolution: later systems retain low-confidence candidates and explicit admission/full-text boundaries

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: Three early budget dimensions are recorded as a concern; no universal fixed query/provider promise is asserted.

engineering_decisions.decision: 不以固定筆數掩蓋 provider degradation；把 low-confidence candidates 與 diagnostics 留給 review。

architecture_state.state: topic plan → multiple provider/fallback paths → relevance/ranking diagnostics → review

safe_numbers.value: 3 early budget dimensions are not asserted
safe_numbers.meaning: the historical record shows a budget concern, but does not prove a universal 3-query/3-provider request promise

safe_public_facts.fact: 搜不到、搜歪、provider 掛掉與來源不夠好是不同 failure classes。

retrospective_notes.note: 後來 audit 才發現 nominal cascade 可能 fan out 成多個實際 side effects；不能說早期已經知道這個數字。

publication_risks: 不能把後來 22/6/90 fan-out 數字放進早期 narrative。
不要把 fallback candidate 寫成 accepted evidence。
